set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
pidfile=$base/run/worker.pid
worker=$base/worker.py

read_pid()
{
    [ -f "$pidfile" ] || return 1
    pid=$(cat "$pidfile" 2>/dev/null) || return 1
    case "$pid" in
        ''|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;;
    esac
    [ "$pid" -gt 1 ] 2>/dev/null || return 1
}

pid_is_worker()
{
    check_pid=$1
    kill -0 "$check_pid" 2>/dev/null || return 1
    [ -r "/proc/$check_pid/stat" ] || return 1
    state=$(awk '{print $3}' "/proc/$check_pid/stat" 2>/dev/null) || return 1
    [ "$state" != Z ] || return 1
    [ -r "/proc/$check_pid/cmdline" ] || return 1
    script=$(tr '\000' '\n' < "/proc/$check_pid/cmdline" | sed -n '2p')
    [ "$script" = "$worker" ]
}

case "${1-}" in
    start)
        if read_pid && pid_is_worker "$pid"; then
            printf 'worker already running (pid %s)\n' "$pid"
            exit 0
        fi

        if [ -f "$pidfile" ]; then
            if read_pid && kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then

        new_pid=$!
        tmp=$pidfile.$$
        printf '%s\n' "$new_pid" > "$tmp"
        mv -f "$tmp" "$pidfile"
        sleep 1
        if ! pid_is_worker "$new_pid"; then
            rm -f "$pidfile"
            printf 'worker failed to start\n' >&2
            exit 1
        fi
        printf 'worker started (pid %s)\n' "$new_pid"

        if ! read_pid; then
            if [ -f "$pidfile" ]; then
                rm -f "$pidfile"
                printf 'removed invalid stale PID file\n'
            else
                printf 'worker is not running\n'
            fi
            exit 0
        fi

        if ! pid_is_worker "$pid"; then
            if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
                printf 'not stopping unrelated process %s; removing PID file\n' "$pid"
            else
                printf 'removing stale PID file for process %s\n' "$pid"
            fi
            rm -f "$pidfile"
            exit 0
        fi

        kill "$pid"
        tries=0
        while pid_is_worker "$pid"; do
            tries=$((tries + 1))
            if [ "$tries" -ge 5 ]; then
                printf 'worker %s did not stop\n' "$pid" >&2
                exit 1
            fi
            sleep 1
        done
        rm -f "$pidfile"
        printf 'worker stopped (pid %s)\n' "$pid"

            else
                printf 'worker is not running\n'
            fi
            exit 1

        if pid_is_worker "$pid"; then
            printf 'worker is running (pid %s)\n' "$pid"
            exit 0
        fi
        if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
            printf 'worker is not running (pid %s belongs to another process)\n' "$pid"
        else
            printf 'worker is not running (stale pid %s)\n' "$pid"
        fi
        exit 1
        ;;
    *)
        printf 'usage: %s {start|stop|status}\n' "$0" >&2

        ;;
